pages.text: Xero's AI Toolkit — Xero Developer Skip to main content Getting Started Grow with Xero Documentation Tools Support Sign up Log in Main content start The Rise of the Builder: Build Next-Gen Xero Integrations with Xero’s AI toolkit Build innovative accounting integrations and intelligent automation powered by Xero's MCP Server, Command Line Interface, OpenAI Agents SDK and LangChain. Xero's AI Toolkit The most successful developers right now are "Vibe Architects." They use vibe coding to quickly generate the "bones" of an app or agent but then use a CLI and professional frameworks (like LangChain , AutoGen , or MCP ) to lock down the logic and ensure it doesn't hallucinate in production. And we've got it all here for you! Give your AI apps and agents the power of Xero's platform. Agentic SDK Comprehensive collection of examples demonstrating how to build AI agents that integrate with the Xero API using various agentic frameworks and the Xero MCP Server. Review the Xero Agentic SDK Remote MCP Server Securely and seamlessly connect Agents to Xero data through a Xero-hosted MCP server. Try Xero's MCP Server Xero Command Line Interface (CLI) This tool wraps the Xero API to provide a high-performance bridge for autonomous systems. Check out Xero's CLI Prompt Library and Code Samples Xero's collection of pre-written text prompts, and code samples to help you get started. Check out Xero's prompt library Xero's AI Learning Series: Automation Unleashed and The Rise of the Builder Join Xero Developer as we dive deep into the world of AI development tools to show practical ways to streamline Xero workflow. These videos on vibecoding and low-code / no-code tools will give you the edge you need to build solutions that solve real problems specific to your needs. These are just a few we've recorded, but more are available on the Xero Developer YouTube channel. pages.text: Global App Awards — Xero Developer Skip to main content Getting Started Grow with Xero Documentation Tools Support Sign up Log in Main content start Celebrating apps that drive innovation and impact Be recognised. Be trusted. Be global. Award categories Get ready to shine! Our award categories are crafted to celebrate the creativity, innovation, and impact of apps delivered to its users. 🌍 Global Awards: app must be available in all 3 regions Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States 📍 Regional Awards: Asia, Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, South Africa, the United Kingdom, the United States 2027 Coming soon... Practice App of the Year This award celebrates apps that empower accounting and bookkeeping practices with meaningful, regionally relevant impact. 🌍 📍 Small Business App of the Year This award celebrates apps that make life easier for small businesses and help them thrive. 🌍 📍 Emerging App of the Year This award recognises early-stage apps with high potential and strong traction in their region. 🌍 Innovation App of the Year This award honours bold, breakthrough ideas that change how work gets done. 🌍 People's Choice Award Voted by the Xero community, this award recognises the app that’s captured the hearts (and clicks) of users around the world. Check out the guide and toolkit here . 🌍 Development Partner of the Year Recognising the builders, agencies and developers who are helping small businesses and accountants to expand Xero. 🌍 Why apply? Nominating your app to the Xero Global App Awards is more than just entering a competition, it’s your chance to celebrate your team's hard work and showcase what sets your app apart. Boost your visibility Finalists and winners get a Xero Awards promo pack with assets and expert tips to amplify your success. Trusted by the community Show the Xero community your app’s impact with an award-winning badge that highlights innovation and real user value. Inspire your team Celebrate your collective achievements, fuel team pride, and attract top talent who want to join a winning team. 🚀 Ready to grow, connect, and be recognised? Showcase your innovation. Inspire the Xero community. And get the recognition you’ve earned. Entries open 20 April 2026 and close 10 July 2026.
